title: Speed: moving towards each other
question: Town P and Town Q are 300 km apart. A car leaves Town P for Town Q at 70 km/h. At the same time, a van leaves Town Q for Town P at 50 km/h. After how many hours will they meet?

relations.from: A car leaves Town P for Town Q at 70 km/h
a van leaves Town Q for Town P at 50 km/h
Town P and Town Q are 300 km apart

timeline.say: Town P and Town Q are 300 km apart. A car leaves Town P for Town Q at 70 km/h. At the same time, a van leaves Town Q for Town P at 50 km/h. After how many hours will they meet?
The car goes 70 kilometres every hour.
The van comes the other way at 50 kilometres every hour.
Let's draw the road. The car starts at P, the van at Q, and they meet in between.
Pause and think. Together, how much closer do they get every hour?
Every hour they get 70 plus 50, which is 120 kilometres closer.
By then the car has gone 2.5 times 70, which is 175 kilometres.
Let's check: 175 kilometres plus the van's 125 kilometres make 300. It works!
So, they meet after 2.5 hours. Well done!
